risk_note: RV2 by path (db, platform maintenance). BR-ID-30 retention cleanup, first batch (D10-451 / D10-454 / D10-457 / D10-458). Migration 0102: one SECURITY DEFINER function per table, EXECUTE for couli_maint only, batched with SKIP LOCKED, fixed +08:00 calendar-day cutoff, with the floor enforced inside each function as a second gate: login_logs, device_registrations, inbox_messages 180 days, notify_logs (all channels), sms_send_attempts 190 days by created_at; deleted_identities by expire_at. Five created_at indexes. couli_maint has no table privilege on config_items ([AC-F1-02a#12], roles.sql only EXECUTE): the SECURITY DEFINER function app.read_retention_settings returns only keys with the retention. prefix. Maintenance section K runs inside the existing 04:00 gate after the open-attempts cleanup: retention.purge.enabled off skips the batch, days come from retention.<table>_days, a missing, invalid or below-floor value falls back to the 08 value and the table is still cleaned; one table failing does not stop the others; logs carry table and row count only; the report shape is unchanged. Not touched: order_sync_drop_keys (D10-457), blocklist (D10-454), audit, ledger, order and withdrawal tables. db/schema.sql regenerated from a live database.
